technical.summary: Bullish technical structure with strong moving average alignment and positive momentum crossovers, but overbought conditions, weak trend strength (ADX 22.51), negative money flow, and below-average volume limit conviction for a high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: AEP shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 45 days present material risk with no offsetting fundamental or smart money support.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (22/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is stale (270+ days old) with only small sales and no conviction signal.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (290.4) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinationals, and imminent CPI event adds binary risk; utilities defensive but credit spreads widening in risk-off environment.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong technical structure (price above all major MAs, supertrend bullish, MACD/PPO crossovers up) combined with extreme fear sentiment (22/100) creates a contrarian entry opportunity in a defensive utility sector.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment is severely hostile (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels, strong dollar headwind) with overbought technicals (stoch/Williams %R), negative money flow, weak trend strength (ADX 22.51), below-average volume, zero fundamental support, and earnings risk in 45 days—technical setup is fragile without institutional conviction.

decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve and VIX crisis levels signal recession risk that will likely override technical strength; earnings in 45 days add binary event risk with zero fundamental or smart money support.
